scan_basis.runtime_note: No Railway API credentials or live deployment logs were available during this scan; runtime stability is inferred from repository configuration and code paths.

GREEN.label: operational_safe
GREEN.description: The module is ready for controlled production use after normal secret validation.

YELLOW.label: needs_attention
YELLOW.description: The module can operate, but requires hardening, monitoring, or deployment validation.

RED.label: critical_blocker
RED.description: The module should not be scaled or monetized until the blocker is fixed.

signals: Dynamic server/runtime modules must remain available in Railway build context
core_modules.primary_action: Normalize duplicate routes and validate Railway build/watch coverage for server/runtime.

signals: Financial wallet and transaction read endpoints are open
Several runtime and business-intelligence read endpoints are open
Webhook safety depends on production secrets and durable DATABASE_URL-backed idempotency
core_modules.primary_action: Add auth to financial reads and classify every runtime endpoint as public, internal, or admin-only.

signals: Worker-like jobs are HTTP-triggered instead of supervised
Local memory fallback can be lost on Railway restart
Live crash/restart/log state was not observable from the repository-only scan
core_modules.primary_action: Add Railway worker or cron execution for task, radar, and PIX followup cycles.

signals: Subscription, credit-pack, radar-checkout, and entitlement endpoints are present
Credits plus radar signals form the highest-value first SaaS package
core_modules.primary_action: Activate monetization only after security, database, and webhook production gates pass.

signals: ESM TypeScript API depends on CommonJS runtime modules
Static/demo conversion surfaces share production API namespace
core_modules.primary_action: Consolidate route ownership and document the TypeScript-to-CJS runtime boundary.

CRITICAL.recommended_fix: Apply financial read auth or an admin-only middleware before production exposure.

CRITICAL.issue: Webhook idempotency becomes non-durable without DATABASE_URL
CRITICAL.impact: duplicate or lost payment processing after restarts
evidence: Mercado Pago webhook local memory fallback
payment_webhook_events requires Postgres for durable replay protection
CRITICAL.recommended_fix: Make DATABASE_URL healthy before enabling production payment webhooks.

CRITICAL.issue: Worker-like monetization jobs have no supervised retry loop
CRITICAL.impact: paid task loss or inconsistent execution
CRITICAL.recommended_fix: Move scheduled cycles to a Railway worker/cron with retry and alerting.

HIGH.impact: shadowed handlers and confusing API contracts
HIGH.recommended_fix: Assign one route owner and remove duplicate definitions.

HIGH.issue: Runtime modules live outside the API artifact path
HIGH.impact: Railway build or watch rules may omit required CommonJS runtime files
HIGH.recommended_fix: Explicitly include server/runtime/** in the API deployment contract.

MEDIUM: Open checkout status endpoint must return only non-sensitive data
Static/demo conversion data should be separated from production API namespace
External observability hooks are optional and were not validated live
LOW: Move generated audit reports into a docs/audits directory over time
Set narrow FINANCIAL_AUTH_SCOPES instead of relying on broad defaults

opportunity_highlights: Transform Railway backend into a paid API product after auth hardening
Package x-radar signals as credit-metered premium intelligence
Sell automation agents through task execution and subscription endpoints
Use PIX checkout and Mercado Pago webhooks as the first real payment rail

activation_gate.reason: Security and webhook durability blockers must be closed before financial scale.
minimum_unlocks: Validate DATABASE_URL and migrations in production
Validate signed Mercado Pago sandbox webhook end-to-end

priority_order: Add auth middleware to financial read and sensitive runtime endpoints
Require durable webhook idempotency with DATABASE_URL
Validate Mercado Pago signature path in sandbox
first_24_hours: Confirm production Railway has PORT, DATABASE_URL, FINANCIAL_AUTH_TOKEN, GOVERNANCE_TOKEN, MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN, MERCADO_PAGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and MERCADO_PAGO_NOTIFICATION_URL
Run JSON/report sanity checks and production env validation scripts
first_7_days: Create a dedicated Railway worker/cron for queued monetization jobs
Add alerting for webhook failures, DB degradation, and job failures
Complete one sandbox PIX checkout through webhook, ledger, and wallet credit activation

final_insight.summary: GXEON already has strong monetizable structure, but it is not safe to scale financially until authentication, webhook durability, worker retry, and live monitoring gates are closed.
final_insight.executive_decision: Prioritize security and runtime stability before expanding paid API access.
